title: Google Analytics 4 MCP (GA4)
headline: Talk to your GA4 traffic, engagement and recorded outcomes in your AI client.
summary: Read-only GA4 property discovery, native reports, acquisition presets, recorded events and ordered funnels through 19 Typenode-hosted MCP tools.
description: A reusable Google Analytics 4 MCP template for marketing and SEO managers. Official Analytics Admin and Data API reads expose native reporting evidence with compatibility checks and bounded results. The AI client owns interpretation; the server does not change measurement configuration or reconstruct unrecorded business outcomes.
first_use_prompts: List the Google Analytics properties I can access.
For my selected property, show sessions and engagement from Google organic landing pages for the last complete month.
Show recorded event names before we choose an outcome event to inspect.
prerequisites: Typenode Workspace with setup and publication access; normal account/billing prerequisites apply.
Customer-owned Google Cloud project and custom OAuth Web application.
Enabled APIs: Google Analytics Data API, Google Analytics Admin API.
Google account with access to each selected reporting property.
AI client supporting the authenticated Typenode remote MCP endpoint.
